speaker: sam_latchet
text: There. I am bowing to it from here. The door is as far as I go until you say.

speaker: george_bryan
text: That bow will do. Stay in it a moment so you know the feeling, and then stand up like a boy who has work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fastening is finished. Somebody's hands, not mine. The crown stays on the trestle until it is wanted, and it is not wanted as a toy.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt not look at the state. Thou wilt see it. White staff or none, the seeing is not a stare. We have said the line enough times in a chamber.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Armado is dressed. If she laughs I shall know it was the part, and if she does not I shall still have said what is set down.

speaker: george_bryan
text: What is set down is the part. Will Kemp. Not three lines over. Not to her face. A laugh you have not been given is not a licence.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have heard you, George. Set down is a long country. I know the roads in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Know them, and stay on the one we copied. I am not in the humour to explain thee in a buttery after.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Nobody touches a hanging. Nobody begins with a yeoman. Sam, your bow through the door is the last practice. The next bow is in the room, and it is not a trick.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The next one has a person. I can tell a person from a chair. I have two hours in my head and I am keeping both.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Keep them quietly. A whisper here is already too much. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Nine, and about ten. I am going in first when they open it, and I am not looking up.
